fixtures.utterance: Retry accounting event 018f0a1b-2c3d-7e4f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b, it failed on a timeout.
fixtures.notes: #2374: a posting to accounting, so HIGH whatever the classifier says. AccountingEventWriteGuard reads the event as the caller before the preview and requires FAILED; the preview names the event id, type, source and amount, the rules a retry posts under (dry-run, unpinned), says a journal entry will post and that there is no undo (the correction is a reversing entry). The event is re-inspected before execution: an event that left FAILED, or rules that changed, cancel the plan as stale data. Arguments carrying their own Authorization header are refused.

fixtures.utterance: Reprocess suspended event 018f0a1b-2c3d-7e4f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5c now that the CASH_SALE mapping is fixed.
fixtures.notes: #2374: the event must be SUSPENDED when previewed and again when confirmed. With mappingVersionToUse the posting is pinned to that version; without it the guard dry-runs the rules (resolveTestMapping) and the preview names the matched rule version, or the default GL mappings, and the lines. The preview's fingerprint is pinned with the plan, so a rule change before confirmation cancels it as stale.

fixtures.utterance: Post accounting event 018f0a1b-2c3d-7e4f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5d again, retry it.
fixtures.notes: #2374: the event is PROCESSED. The guard refuses before any preview (NEEDS_CLARIFICATION with preconditionFailed on the NLTI path, an Error: result on the chat path): a posted entry is corrected with a reversing entry, never by posting the event again. pos-accounting's retry does not check the status itself.

fixtures.utterance: The retry on event 018f0a1b-2c3d-7e4f-8a9b-0c1d2e3f4a5b timed out, just retry it again.
fixtures.notes: #2374: an unknown or timed-out outcome is never retried blindly. The assistant reads the event (accounting_getaccountingevent) and its reprocessing history first; RECEIVED or PROCESSING means the earlier attempt may still be running, and the guard refuses.
